raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
> Part of the MiniMax-M3.1-Flash AMD series that replaces #45936 (closed with its base branch `minimax-m3.1-flash`): kernel PRs #46690 (attention), #46691 (MoE / GEMM) and #46692 (quick all-reduce), each on `main`; then #46693 with the M3.1 call sites and #46694 (indexer CP). It follows the DeepSeek-V4.1 AMD layout (#41018-#41021, then #41308).

## Summary
- A JIT copy of sgl-kernel's quick all-reduce (`jit/csrc/distributed/quick_all_reduce/`, `quick_all_reduce_hip.cuh`, `ops/communication/quick_all_reduce_hip.py`), restructured for latency (the per-tile wire layout is wave-major) and cut to the INT4 / INT8 codecs at TP4 on bf16 data. It keeps sgl-kernel's buffer sizes, flags and arithmetic, so at the level it runs its outputs are bitwise equal to sgl-kernel's, including a partial last tile and bf16 values past fp16's range. Asked for INT4, it runs all-reduces below `SGLANG_ROCM_QUICK_REDUCE_INT8_BELOW_MB` (default 64 MiB; 0 keeps INT4 at every size) in INT8, about 1/16 of INT4's error, and logs that once at init; the JIT INT4 column below 64 MB in the table is the kernel called at INT4 directly. `jit_serves()` takes only gfx950, and `qr_supports(fa, dtype)` tells a caller that a JIT handle reduces bf16 only.
- Nothing in this PR calls the module: #46693 wires it in (`custom_all_reduce_ops` behind `SGLANG_ROCM_QUICK_ALL_REDUCE_JIT`, on gfx950 only, the GPU it is validated on; `QuickAllReduce` asks `qr_supports()` so float16 goes to the next all-reduce). Review it here as a kernel; the serving numbers below come from #46693.

## Changes to existing kernels
None; every source file is new and HIP-only. The existing `test_quick_allreduce_bf16_range` gains the JIT cases.

## Not in this PR
- Each communicator allocates twice its max size (4 GiB per GPU at the 2 GiB default), as sgl-kernel's does, although the kernel indexes its slots by block and so uses at most 256 tiles per phase. Shrinking it would return that memory to the KV cache; it is left for a follow-up.
- sgl-kernel's own `quick_all_reduce.h` keeps `data_buffer_size` function-static, so the first communicator's size sticks process-wide; this JIT copy sizes it per communicator and leaves the original untouched.

## Verification
- MI350X (ROCm 7.2 image, AITER `acf8fdf93`), this branch alone on `main`: `test_quick_allreduce_bf16_range` 3 passed (8 GPUs). pre-commit clean.
- Latency at TP4 on MI350X, bf16 messages, eager, us per all-reduce (sgl-kernel = the AOT `qr_all_reduce` this replaces):

| Message | aiter bf16 custom AR | sgl-kernel INT8 | JIT INT8 | JIT / sgl-kernel | sgl-kernel INT4 | JIT INT4 | JIT / sgl-kernel |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 1 MB | 18.4 | 29.6 | 14.2 | 0.48 | 26.9 | 13.7 | 0.51 |
| 2.4 MB | 28.1 | 40.5 | 20.1 | 0.49 | 31.9 | 16.7 | 0.52 |
| 8 MB | 79.2 | 92.8 | 51.3 | 0.55 | 56.7 | 38.3 | 0.68 |
| 32 MB | 389.3 | 267.8 | 177.6 | 0.66 | 157.9 | 104.2 | 0.66 |
| 63 MB | 576.8 | 446.8 | 345.9 | 0.77 | 261.7 | 194.8 | 0.74 |
| 128 MB | | 1003.0 | 699.5 | 0.70 | 462.2 | 391.7 | 0.85 |
| 400 MB | | 2308.6 | 2181.6 | 0.94 | 1415.5 | 1249.5 | 0.88 |

  The JIT INT8 beats aiter's bf16 custom all-reduce from 1 MB, where sgl-kernel's INT8 does not until about 16 MB; that is what lets the integration PR lower aiter's custom-AR cutoff to 2.4 MiB. One run; single-size outliers in other columns (RCCL at 8 MB, sgl-kernel INT4 at 16 and 256 MB) were left out.
- Serving, measured in the integration PR (MI350X TP 4, NVFP4 KV, DSpark acceptance simulated at 3 tokens per step, 32K-token contexts, two repeats on each of two GPU sets). With sgl-kernel's quick all-reduce instead (`SGLANG_ROCM_QUICK_ALL_REDUCE_JIT=0`) at the same 2.4 MiB custom-AR cutoff, decode TPOT grows 4.0% at 32 concurrent requests and 2.6% at 64, and 32K-token prefill 1.9%. With main's 64 MiB cutoff as well: 3.6%, 6.7% and 4.3%. At 1 and 8 requests every all-reduce stays under the cutoff, on aiter's custom all-reduce.

detail.title: [Feat] [AMD] distributed: JIT quick all-reduce for TP4 on gfx950

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,160 @@
+"""JIT build of sgl-kernel's ROCm quick all-reduce ``qr_*`` calls, for INT4 and INT8 at TP4.
+
+The two-shot kernel (kernels/jit/csrc/distributed/quick_all_reduce/) is laid out for latency but
+keeps sgl-kernel's buffer sizes, flags and arithmetic, so on bf16 cast to fp16 its outputs
+match bitwise. Asked for INT4, it runs the all-reduces below
+SGLANG_ROCM_QUICK_REDUCE_INT8_BELOW_MB (64 MiB) in INT8. A group it does not serve (not gfx950,
+another world size or level, no bf16 -> fp16 cast) gets sgl-kernel's quick all-reduce. It reduces
+bf16 only; a caller checks qr_supports() before handing it another dtype.
+"""
+
+import logging
+import os
+from typing import Optional
+
+import sgl_kernel.allreduce as sgl_kernel_qr
+import torch
+
+from sglang.kernels.jit.utils import cache_once, load_jit
+from sglang.srt.environ import envs
+from sglang.srt.utils import is_gfx95_supported
+
+logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
+
+_ENTRY_POINTS = (
+    "init",
+    "get_handle",
+    "open_handles",
+    "all_reduce",
+    "destroy",
+    "handle_bytes",
+)
+
+# Grid cap, also sizing the flags; measured best on MI350X TP4 INT4.
+_MAX_BLOCKS = 256
+
+# Max bytes per all-reduce when the caller passes none: sgl-kernel's qr_max_size().
+_DEFAULT_MAX_SIZE = 1 << 31
+
+# sgl-kernel's QuickReduceQuantLevel
+_INT8, _INT4 = 1, 3
+
+
+@cache_once
+def _module():
+    return load_jit(
+        "quick_all_reduce_hip",
+        _MAX_BLOCKS,
+        cuda_files=["distributed/quick_all_reduce_hip.cuh"],
+        cuda_wrappers=[
+            (name, f"quick_all_reduce_hip::QuickAllReduce::{name}")
+            for name in _ENTRY_POINTS
+        ],
+        # sgl-kernel's build defines
+        extra_cuda_cflags=[
+            f"-DQR_MAX_BLOCKS={_MAX_BLOCKS}",
+            "-D__HIP_NO_HALF_OPERATORS__=1",
+            "-D__HIP_NO_HALF_CONVERSIONS__=1",
+        ],
+    )
+
+
+# Handles init_custom_qr took from sgl-kernel, so the other calls route them back there; the
+# handles are process-wide, like the communicators that own them.
+_SGL_KERNEL_HANDLES: set[int] = set()
+# Per JIT handle, the size below which an INT4 request runs INT8: the latency-bound decode and
+# short-extend sizes, where INT8 (about 1/16 of INT4's error) still beats the bf16 custom AR,
+# measured on MI350X TP4; prefill keeps INT4.
+_INT8_BELOW_BYTES: dict[int, int] = {}
+
+
+def jit_serves(world_size: int) -> bool:
+    """Whether the JIT build serves the group at the level and cast ``QuickAllReduce`` reads."""
+    return (
+        world_size == 4
+        and is_gfx95_supported()
+        and os.environ.get("ROCM_QUICK_REDUCE_QUANTIZATION", "NONE") in ("INT4", "INT8")
+        and int(os.environ.get("ROCM_QUICK_REDUCE_CAST_BF16_TO_FP16", 1)) != 0
+    )
+
+
+def init_custom_qr(
+    rank: int, world_size: int, qr_max_size: Optional[int] = None
+) -> int:
+    if jit_serves(world_size):
+        below_mb = envs.SGLANG_ROCM_QUICK_REDUCE_INT8_BELOW_MB.get()
+        if (
+            rank == 0
+            and os.environ["ROCM_QUICK_REDUCE_QUANTIZATION"] == "INT4"
+            and below_mb
+        ):
+            logger.info(
+                "JIT quick all-reduce: INT4 below %d MiB runs INT8; "
+                "SGLANG_ROCM_QUICK_REDUCE_INT8_BELOW_MB=0 keeps INT4 at every size",
+                below_mb,
+            )
+        fa = _module().init(world_size, rank, qr_max_size or 0)
+        _INT8_BELOW_BYTES[fa] = below_mb << 20
+        return fa
+    fa = sgl_kernel_qr.init_custom_qr(world_size, rank, qr_max_size)
+    _SGL_KERNEL_HANDLES.add(fa)
+    return fa
+
+
+def qr_get_handle(fa: int) -> torch.Tensor:
+    if fa in _SGL_KERNEL_HANDLES:
+        return sgl_kernel_qr.qr_get_handle(fa)
+    out = torch.empty(_module().handle_bytes(), dtype=torch.uint8)
+    _module().get_handle(fa, out)
+    return out
+
+
+def qr_open_handles(fa: int, handles: list[torch.Tensor]) -> None:
+    if fa in _SGL_KERNEL_HANDLES:
+        sgl_kernel_qr.qr_open_handles(fa, handles)
+        return
+    _module().open_handles(fa, torch.stack(handles))
+
+
+def qr_supports(fa: int, dtype: torch.dtype) -> bool:
+    """Whether handle ``fa`` reduces ``dtype``: the JIT build takes bf16 only."""
+    return fa in _SGL_KERNEL_HANDLES or dtype == torch.bfloat16
+
+
+def _flat(t: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+    # QuickAllReduce admits weakly contiguous tensors; sgl-kernel reduces their raw memory.
+    return t.as_strided((t.numel(),), (1,))
+
+
+def qr_all_reduce(
+    fa: int,
+    inp: torch.Tensor,
+    out: torch.Tensor,
+    quant_level: int,
+    cast_bf2half: bool,
+) -> None:
+    if fa in _SGL_KERNEL_HANDLES:
+        sgl_kernel_qr.qr_all_reduce(fa, inp, out, quant_level, cast_bf2half)
+        return
+    # init cannot see the dtype; callers route other dtypes elsewhere by qr_supports()
+    if not qr_supports(fa, inp.dtype):
+        raise ValueError(f"the JIT quick all-reduce reduces bf16 only, got {inp.dtype}")
+    if (
+        quant_level == _INT4
+        and inp.numel() * inp.element_size() < _INT8_BELOW_BYTES[fa]
+    ):
+        quant_level = _INT8
+    _module().all_reduce(fa, _flat(inp), _flat(out), quant_level, cast_bf2half)
+
+
+def qr_destroy(fa: int) -> None:
+    if fa in _SGL_KERNEL_HANDLES:
+        _SGL_KERNEL_HANDLES.discard(fa)
+        sgl_kernel_qr.qr_destroy(fa)
+        return
+    _INT8_BELOW_BYTES.pop(fa, None)
+    _module().destroy(fa)
+
+
+def qr_max_size() -> int:
+    return _DEFAULT_MAX_SIZE

@@ -1021,6 +1021,10 @@ class Envs:
     # Enabled by default for supported configurations; set to 0 to disable.
     SGLANG_M3_USE_AITER_FUSED_QKNORM = EnvBool(True)
     SGLANG_USE_AITER_AG = EnvBool(True)
+    # The gfx950 TP4 JIT quick all-reduce (quick_all_reduce_hip) runs an INT4 request below this
+    # many MiB in INT8, which is as fast at decode sizes with about 1/16 of INT4's error; 0 runs
+    # INT4 at every size.
+    SGLANG_ROCM_QUICK_REDUCE_INT8_BELOW_MB = EnvInt(64)
     # Use reduce_scatter (instead of all_reduce + dp_scatter) for the equal-chunk
     # MAX_LEN DP-MoE combine. Default ON for ROCm/HIP (uses the aiter custom
     # symmetric-memory kernel), OFF elsewhere (would fall back to RCCL); override

@@ -9,13 +9,15 @@
 
 from sglang.srt.distributed.device_communicators.quick_all_reduce import (
     QuickAllReduce,
+    QuickReduceRegime,
     qr_rocm_arch_available,
 )
+from sglang.srt.utils import is_gfx95_supported
 from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_amd_ci
 from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
 
 register_amd_ci(est_time=30, suite="stage-c-test-4-gpu-amd")
-register_amd_ci(est_time=30, suite="stage-c-test-large-8-gpu-amd-mi35x")
+register_amd_ci(est_time=120, suite="stage-c-test-large-8-gpu-amd-mi35x")
 
 
 def _get_open_port() -> int:
@@ -80,41 +82,204 @@ def _run_bf16_range_test(rank: int, world_size: int, port: int) -> None:
         dist.destroy_process_group()
 
 
+_INT8 = QuickReduceRegime.INT8.value
+_INT6 = QuickReduceRegime.INT6.value
+_INT4 = QuickReduceRegime.INT4.value
+
+
+def _open_comms(rank: int, world_size: int) -> tuple[int, int]:
+    import sgl_kernel.allreduce as aot
+
+    from sglang.kernels.ops.communication import quick_all_reduce_hip as jit
+
+    def open_comm(init, get_handle, open_handles):
+        handle = init(rank, world_size, 128 << 20)
+        handles = [None] * world_size
+        dist.all_gather_object(handles, get_handle(handle))
+        open_handles(handle, handles)
+        return handle
+
+    # sgl_kernel.allreduce takes (world_size, rank), the JIT module the reverse.
+    aot_comm = open_comm(
+        lambda r, w, m: aot.init_custom_qr(w, r, m),
+        aot.qr_get_handle,
+        aot.qr_open_handles,
+    )
+    jit_comm = open_comm(jit.init_custom_qr, jit.qr_get_handle, jit.qr_open_handles)
+    return aot_comm, jit_comm
+
+
+def _run_jit_bitwise_test(rank: int, world_size: int, port: int) -> None:
+    import sgl_kernel.allreduce as aot
+
+    from sglang.kernels.ops.communication import quick_all_reduce_hip as jit
+
+    os.environ["ROCM_QUICK_REDUCE_QUANTIZATION"] = "INT4"
+    os.environ["ROCM_QUICK_REDUCE_CAST_BF16_TO_FP16"] = "1"
+    device = torch.device(f"cuda:{rank}")
+    torch.cuda.set_device(device)
+    dist.init_process_group(
+        backend="gloo",
+        init_method=f"tcp://127.0.0.1:{port}",
+        rank=rank,
+        world_size=world_size,
+    )
+
+    try:
+        aot_comm, jit_comm = _open_comms(rank, world_size)
+        generator = torch.Generator(device=device).manual_seed(rank)
+        # (requested level, level it runs): asked for INT4, the JIT build runs INT8 below 64 MiB;
+        # at 32 KB a tile, the last three have more tiles than blocks (grid-stride loop)
+        for numel, level, runs in (
+            (171 * 6144, _INT4, _INT8),  # a partial last tile
+            (384 * 6144, _INT4, _INT8),
+            (4096 * 6144, _INT4, _INT8),
+            (6144 * 6144, _INT4, _INT4),
+            (6144 * 6144, _INT8, _INT8),
+        ):
+            inp = torch.randn(numel, device=device, generator=generator).bfloat16()
+            inp[::4099] *= 64
+            # past fp16's range, where the bf16 -> fp16 cast must saturate as sgl-kernel's does
+            inp[1::65537] = 80000.0
+            expected, out = torch.empty_like(inp), torch.empty_like(inp)
+            for _ in range(2):
+                aot.qr_all_reduce(aot_comm, inp, expected, runs, True)
+                jit.qr_all_reduce(jit_comm, inp, out, level, True)
+            torch.cuda.synchronize()
+            assert torch.equal(out.view(torch.int16), expected.view(torch.int16)), (
+                f"{numel=} {level=}: JIT quick all-reduce differs from sgl-kernel's"
+            )
+        try:
+            jit.qr_all_reduce(jit_comm, inp, out, _INT6, True)
+        except RuntimeError:
+            pass
+        else:
+            raise AssertionError("the INT4 / INT8 JIT build ran INT6")
+        # a caller asks qr_supports() first, so a float16 model keeps another all-reduce
+        assert jit.qr_supports(jit_comm, torch.bfloat16)
+        assert not jit.qr_supports(jit_comm, torch.float16)
+        try:
+            jit.qr_all_reduce(jit_comm, inp.half(), out.half(), _INT8, True)
+        except ValueError:
+            pass
+        else:
+            raise AssertionError("the bf16-only JIT build took float16")
+        jit.qr_destroy(jit_comm)
+        aot.qr_destroy(aot_comm)
+
+        # with the INT8 threshold at 0, an INT4 request runs INT4 at decode sizes too
+        os.environ["SGLANG_ROCM_QUICK_REDUCE_INT8_BELOW_MB"] = "0"
+        aot_comm, jit_comm = _open_comms(rank, world_size)
+        inp = torch.randn(384 * 6144, device=device, generator=generator).bfloat16()
+        expected, out = torch.empty_like(inp), torch.empty_like(inp)
+        aot.qr_all_reduce(aot_comm, inp, expected, _INT4, True)
+        jit.qr_all_reduce(jit_comm, inp, out, _INT4, True)
+        torch.cuda.synchronize()
+        assert torch.equal(out.view(torch.int16), expected.view(torch.int16)), (
+            "with SGLANG_ROCM_QUICK_REDUCE_INT8_BELOW_MB=0 the JIT build did not run INT4"
+        )

+def _spawn(test_case, target, world_size, name):
+    port = _get_open_port()
+    context = multiprocessing.get_context("spawn")
+    processes = [
+        context.Process(target=target, args=(rank, world_size, port))
+        for rank in range(world_size)
+    ]
+    for process in processes:
+        process.start()
+    deadline = time.monotonic() + 300
+    for process in processes:
+        process.join(max(0, deadline - time.monotonic()))
+    if any(process.is_alive() for process in processes):
+        for process in processes:
+            if process.is_alive():
+                process.terminate()
+                process.join()
+        test_case.fail(f"{name} timed out")
+    for rank, process in enumerate(processes):
+        test_case.assertEqual(process.exitcode, 0, f"{name} failed on rank {rank}")
